plan.summary: Prepare the guest room for Friday arrival by cleaning, washing bedding, and setting out fresh towels and décor.

steps.title: Gather cleaning supplies
steps.description: Collect all necessary items such as cleaning spray, microfiber cloth, vacuum, laundry detergent, fresh linens, towels, decorative items, and a scented candle.

steps.title: Dust surfaces
steps.description: Use a microfiber cloth to dust all surfaces, including shelves, picture frames, and baseboards.

steps.title: Vacuum carpet
steps.description: Vacuum the carpet or rug thoroughly to remove dust and debris.

steps.title: Wash bedding
steps.description: Place used bedding in the washing machine with detergent, wash on a suitable cycle, and dry completely.

steps.title: Fold and arrange linens
steps.description: Fold fresh sheets, pillowcases, and blankets neatly and place them on the bed.

steps.title: Set out towels
steps.description: Fold and arrange fresh towels on the bathroom shelf and a towel rack in the guest room.

steps.title: Arrange décor
steps.description: Place decorative items such as a vase, photo frame, or small plant to enhance the room's appearance.

steps.title: Check lighting
steps.description: Ensure all lights are working and adjust brightness or add lamps if needed.

steps.title: Add scent
steps.description: Light a scented candle or use a subtle room spray to create a welcoming aroma.

steps.title: Final inspection
steps.description: Walk through the room to confirm cleanliness, proper arrangement, and overall readiness.

cautions: Avoid using harsh chemicals on delicate surfaces
Ensure towels are fully dry before use
